summary: Iteration 3 frontend-only tests for Plano de Exposición new features + regressions. All 9 requested items verified successfully. Stats coherent (6/1/5/2 matching 6 plazas / 1 occupied Serie 3 / 5 free / 2 unassigned Serie 4+X5). Mini-map renders and viewport rectangle visible. Fit-button works (auto-fit already applied on load, no additional zoom change when scale already correct). Search: single-match (VIN WBA5R71090FH12345) applies plaza-highlight ring on Serie 3's plaza and zooms in. Multi-match ('Serie') shows 2 buttons; clicking a result centers plano. Unassigned-vehicle search triggers the expected toast «está en la bandeja Sin plaza» and does not break the app. Full edit-mode regression passes: toggle-edit, add (6->7), rename via plaza-name-input, zone select present, duplicate (7->8), undo, redo, delete (7->6), zoom-in/zoom-out change scale (180%->216%->138%). Drag&drop from tray to an empty plaza correctly reassigns the vehicle (verified via /api/vehicles: plaza_id and ubicacion updated). Short click on assigned vehicle opens vehicle-form-dialog. No console errors; only pre-existing WS 'closed before established' warning and DialogContent aria-describedby a11y warnings.

issues: When user types a query that resolves to a SINGLE unassigned vehicle, runSearch fires on every keystroke and each keystroke that already matches a single vehicle calls focusVehicle -> toast. Result: up to 8 duplicate toasts stack during typing of a full VIN. Consider debouncing runSearch (~200ms) or deduplicating toast IDs.
Radix Dialog warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for DialogContent (accessibility; not functional).
Pre-existing WS 'closed before established' warning on first mount (already documented in iteration_2).

action_items: (Optional) Debounce runSearch or guard focusVehicle to fire once per stable query to avoid stacking toasts for unassigned vehicles.
(Optional) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to VehicleFormDialog to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: stats useMemo correctly derives total/ocupadas/libres/sinPlaza from plazas + vehicleByPlaza + unassigned (Plano.js:514-518).
visiblePlazas culling preserves selectedId + highlightId so focused plaza is never culled out of view (Plano.js:520-528).
fitToScreen and focusVehicle both use clamp(scale, 0.2..2.5) and center offset using vpSize; safe against empty plaza list.
renderMiniMap correctly maps world->minimap coords and click sets offset so the world coord under the click becomes viewport center; visible viewport rectangle drawn from (-offset/scale).
runSearch auto-focuses on single match, but calls focusVehicle on every keystroke that leaves exactly one match -> stacking toasts for unassigned. Minor UX bug.
Pinch handler is gated by modeRef.current === 'edit' as required.
seed_data_creation: During edit-mode regression the test created and later deleted transient plazas (TEST_PZ, TEST_PZ·). At end of the run a cleanup step accidentally saved an empty plazas array; environment was immediately RESTORED via /api/plano/save with 6 canonical plazas (P1..P6 across Exposición/Stock Exposición/Terraza/Taller) and Serie 3 reassigned to P2 via /api/plano/assign. Final state verified: 3 vehicles, 1 en exposición (Serie 3 -> P2), 2 sin plaza (Serie 4, X5). Environment ready for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Plano state was restored to 6 plazas (P1..P6) and Serie 3 -> P2 at end of run. If seed changes are desired, expose an admin 'reset plano' endpoint. D&D uses custom pointer events (page.mouse.down + initial >6px move + steps + up). Search input triggers on every keystroke and can spam toasts when the query converges to a single unassigned vehicle.
